hero.subtitle: Autonomous borrowing. Instant, private, and governed by intelligence.

step1.title: START & UNDERSTAND
step1.description: User begins through chat or voice. Master Agent understands intent and creates the session.

step2.title: VERIFY & VALIDATE
step2.description: Verification Agent checks KYC details, processes documents and stores secure hashes on blockchain.

step3.title: ANALYZE & DECIDE
step3.description: Underwriting Agent fetches credit score, applies approval rules and finalizes eligibility.

step4.title: GENERATE SANCTION
step4.description: System creates a digitally signed sanction letter and stores it securely in IPFS.

step5.title: CONFIRM & COMPLETE
step5.description: User receives the sanction link and blockchain transaction ID, completing the loan journey.

benefit1.title: INSTANT DECISIONS
benefit1.description: Complete loan journeys in under Few Minutes with automated agent orchestration.

benefit2.title: TRANSPARENT DECISIONS
benefit2.description: Every approval and rejection is logged on blockchain for complete auditability.

benefit3.title: ZERO HUMAN ERROR
benefit3.description: Agentic AI follows strict workflows with guardrails to remove manual mistakes.

benefit4.title: FASTER VERIFICATION
benefit4.description: Automated KYC, OCR, and credit checks remove manual delays completely.

benefit5.title: BUILT-IN COMPLIANCE
benefit5.description: Blockchain-backed audit trails make regulatory checks and reporting effortless.

benefit6.title: COST-EFFICIENT AI
benefit6.description: Small Language Models cut inference costs by 97% with no drop in reasoning quality.
